name: manual_95e295
claim: Before starting a requested "reanchor this stale branch onto main after a squash-merge" task, check the target branch/PR's CURRENT state first -- it may have already been merged or closed by the time the request is made, especially in a fast-moving multi-agent environment where other sessions or the human operator may act on a PR between when a task is described and when work on it begins. A few seconds of state-checking (one API call) avoids doing unnecessary reanchor work on an already-resolved branch, and avoids reporting confusing progress on a PR that no longer needs it.

decisions.notes: Cheap state-check before starting a described task, avoiding wasted reanchor work.

rationale: Cheap state-check before starting a described task, avoiding wasted reanchor work.
